title: Spring extension under load
intro: A spring was loaded with six weights (N) and its extension measured (mm). The least-squares line is ŷ = 0.1333 + 0.2000x. Each residual is the measured extension minus the line's value; their squares add up to SS error, and σ̂ = √(SS error/(n − 2)) is their typical size. The residuals alternate in sign with no curve or funnel, and none is large next to σ̂.
